kfold.term: plus a size curve on log TVL
plus how long it has run tokenless

note: Every figure here is measured on this snapshot alone, by the entry's own lab script. A k-fold figure trains and tests on the same snapshot; a forward figure trains only on protocols listed earlier than the year it tests. The model uses a flat category multiple because no added term improved held-out error on this evidence.
kfold_note: 5-fold, folds assigned by a hash of the slug, so every traded protocol is tested exactly once. This measures whether the terms fit this snapshot; it cannot say whether they survive a later day.
forward_note: Train on protocols listed before the test year, predict the ones listed inside it. The four-term model does far worse here than the flat one, which is why the board prices with the flat multiple: the added terms were fitting the snapshot, not the protocol.
verdict: The board uses the flat category multiple. On this snapshot the size curve looks better in k-fold and much worse forward, and a model that only wins inside one snapshot has not been shown to work.
